title: Best Cutting Board (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by reviewing the product names and rankings listed in the CNET and ChopchopUSA sources. The best overall pick was taken from CNET’s top‑rated board, while other picks were selected from the same source or from ChopchopUSA’s titanium lineup.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because no source provides a price for the John Boos board.

verdict.line: Picture a home cook who needs a sturdy, knife‑friendly surface for everyday meal prep. The John Boos maple board offers a solid hardwood surface that resists knife marks and is easy to clean. Its only drawback is that it is heavier than plastic options.
